scripts.stage: mkdir -p assets/fonts && cp ../../apps/web/test/approved/pages-welcome--fresh.png ../../apps/web/test/approved/store-filecard--filed.png ../../apps/web/test/approved/look-run--ladder.png ../../apps/web/test/approved/run-steppart--waits-on-you.png ../../apps/web/test/approved/factory-factorycanvas--runs-on-the-floor.png ../../apps/web/test/approved/run-first-hint--landed.png assets/ && for f in michroma/files/michroma-latin-400-normal barlow/files/barlow-latin-400-normal barlow/files/barlow-latin-500-normal jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal; do cp ../../node_modules/@fontsource/$f.woff2 assets/fonts/; done
scripts.preview: npm run stage && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.99 preview
scripts.lint: npm run stage && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.99 lint
scripts.check: npm run stage && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.99 check
scripts.render: npm run stage && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.99 render --output nemia.mp4
